Topic.label: Lateral and Total Surface Areas of a Cone

Question:
A cone has base radius 5 and height 12. Its lateral surface area is \(k\pi\). Find the value of \(k\).

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_258_q4_question_en.svg)
Solution: The slant height is \(l=\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13\), and \(S_{\text{lateral}}=\pi rl=65\pi\), so \(k=65\).
